mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_users (username, email, full_name, employee_no, title, hashed_password, dept_id, status, is_active) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{fullName}, #{employeeNo}, #{title}, #{hashedPassword}, #{deptId}, #{status}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_users SET email = #{email}, full_name = #{fullName}, employee_no = #{employeeNo}, title = #{title}, dept_id = #{deptId}, status = #{status}, is_active = #{isActive}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_users SET status = #{status}, is_active = #{isActive}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_users SET last_login_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_users SET is_deleted = 1, is_active = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_users WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM t_users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
